scope: Same final geometry, fixed cell, accuracy .01; saved single points only; zero new quantum calls

contact_force_projection_definition.u: unit vector H to selected periodic O image
contact_force_projection_definition.HO_generalized_closing_force: (F_H-F_O) dot u / 2, for H += q*u/2 and O -= q*u/2; q>0 reduces H-O separation
contact_force_projection_definition.sign: Positive favors approach along this artificial pair coordinate; negative favors separation.
contact_force_projection_definition.limitation: Current residual-force projection, NOT a measured hydrogen-bond attraction, isolated pair interaction, curvature or restoring force. Moving H alone distorts N-H; this is a diagnostic projection only.

convergence_limitations: Doubling one direction at a time is sensitivity, not combined-grid convergence.
Gamma replicates retain identical primitive geometry; no longer-period relaxation was allowed.
Coarse .05 eV/A target cannot be replaced by tighter production force accuracy without reoptimization.
